name: Vortex
description: Manifestation d'une réalité parallèle, Vortex émane de la Faille Dimensionnelle. Son existence même crée des distorsions spatio-temporelles, rendant les attaques ennemies imprévisibles et disjointes.

subject.archetype: Vortex - Extra-dimensional Combat Anomaly, reality-warping warrior of L'Incursion Dissonante

loadout.armor_outfit: Fractured military armor fused with living shadow, plates bent by spatial distortion, flesh partially exposed through cracks in dimensional fabric, limbs positioned at impossible angles, surrounded by glitching shadow tendrils detaching from the body, fragments of reality flickering around the silhouette
loadout.arsenal: Corrupted nullification beam forming between outstretched palms, weaponized reality collapse energy in deep magenta/violet neon, hands glowing with crackling psychic auras that distort light and fracture the air, pure concentrated destruction manifesting as screaming void energy

attitude.behavior: Combat specialist fully committed to the fight, both hands pushed forward in offensive stance, body leaning into the attack with intense focus and deadly precision, moving erratically to avoid targeting systems while channeling reality-destroying energy
attitude.emotion: Transcendent combat focus, absolute concentration on the target, psionic intensity radiating from every pore, terror and ecstasy fused in the expression of a being that has transcended physical limitations

palette_names.name: Abyssal Black
palette_names.role: dominant background and shadow mass, void consuming reality

palette_names.name: Deep Violet
palette_names.role: primary energy manifestation and corruption aura

palette_names.name: Neon Magenta
palette_names.role: glitch effects and high-intensity energy accents

palette_names.name: Scarred Pale Flesh
palette_names.role: exposed body parts and organic elements

color_and_light.lighting_setup: Multiple conflicting light sources from layered dimensions, violet/magenta rim lighting from psychic auras, black corruption darkness consuming edges, reality fracture points emitting discordant illumination
color_and_light.mood: Cosmic dread, reality-shattering violence, transcendent madness, menacing otherworldly power

camera.angle: low_angle slightly dutch tilted to emphasize power and distortion, focusing on the subject's forward thrust

scenography.setting: Reality collapse zone where multiple parallel dimensions overlap simultaneously, buildings existing in both intact and destroyed states as transparent overlays, ground cracking open revealing layered battlefields beneath, fragments of architecture floating chaotically in defiance of physics, sky showing impossible celestial bodies coexisting in the same space
scenography.atmosphere_vfx: Gravity malfunctioning causing debris to fall upward and sideways simultaneously, air fracturing like broken glass around the combatant, chromatic aberration intensifying at dimensional breach points, violet/black psychic static crackling through the atmosphere, reality glitches manifesting as stuttering geometry and color banding, void energy bleeding through dimensional tears
